description: This source file contains unit tests for the SQLite template feature of a project initialization system. It uses pytest fixtures and functions to set up a mock template environment, verify template variable replacements, project initialization, database creation, and content correctness in generated files.

methods.name: temp_dir()
methods.description: Creates a temporary directory for testing, yields it, then cleans it up.

methods.name: template_dir(temp_dir)
methods.description: Sets up a mock template directory structure with configuration and template files for testing.

methods.name: project_config(temp_dir)
methods.description: Creates a sample ProjectConfig object for testing with predefined parameters.

methods.name: test_sqlite_init_info(template_dir, project_config)
methods.description: Verifies retrieval of initial template info includes correct commands.

methods.name: test_project_initialization(template_dir, project_config)
methods.description: Tests the entire project initialization process, generated files, and content correctness.

methods.name: test_database_creation(template_dir, project_config)
methods.description: Runs the init_db.py script to create the database and verifies structure and seeded data.

methods.name: test_default_database_name(template_dir, temp_dir)
methods.description: Checks that the database name defaults correctly based on project name when not specified.

methods.name: test_post_processing_execution(template_dir, project_config, temp_dir)
methods.description: Ensures that post-processing scripts are executed successfully and produce expected side effects.

methods.name: test_config_file_loading(temp_dir)
methods.description: Tests loading a project configuration from a JSON file.

methods.name: test_template_variable_replacement(template_dir, project_config)
methods.description: Verifies that placeholders in templates are correctly replaced with project info.

methods.name: test_sqlite_specific_features(template_dir, project_config)
methods.description: Checks for SQLite-specific behaviors such as lack of auth parameters.

methods.name: test_entry_point_url(template_dir, project_config)
methods.description: Ensures the entry point URL is correctly formed with database name.
